---
name: 🚀 Feature Request
about: RFC and ideas for new features and improvements
labels: [enhancement]
---

**Description**
<!-- A clear and concise description of the new feature. -->

**Use case**
<!-- The problem you are trying to solve, not only the solution you have in mind.
     The scientific or operational context helps us judge scope. -->

**Example**
<!-- A simple example of the new feature in action (include code, links to necessary data, etc.)
     If the new feature changes an existing feature, include a simple before/after comparison. -->

**SPICE equivalent**
<!-- Optional: if this mirrors a cspice routine, name it (e.g. dskx02_c), since
     kerneless deliberately names its API after the routines it replaces.
     Note that some routines are out of scope by design — see the README. -->
